title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_satisfaction_by_lexi_blake_ys40v (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_satisfaction_by_lexi_blake_ys40v' contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or executed. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different, trusted machine.
